title: Vector overlay and RAG chunks
description: Dummy-safe embeddings and retrieve units. RelOp only. The SLM never writes Chroma filters or Mongo pipelines. OverlayChunk is virtual and sandbox-only.

model.note: Deterministic signed bag-of-tokens. Dummy overlay always writes this. RelOp does not change when the retrieve model swaps.

embedding.note: LangChain Embeddings over Chroma ONNX MiniLM, or HuggingFace if installed. The SLM never writes Chroma where-filters — RelOp binds become metadata equality.

demoDocs.text: The bookcase holds office binders. Those shelves keep the same binders neat. Bookcases and shelves are furniture for paper storage.
Chairs fill the conference room. Seating around the conference table is tight. Hon deluxe chairs are seating, not storage.
Demand rose in the West. Sales fell because discounting was heavy. Therefore inventory piled up. After that, volume recovered.
demoDocs.note: Overlay installer remaps rag-cause to a dummy ProductId that appears on a West order line so attach_source/attach_fact can join. Still sandboxOnly.

semantic.note: Kamradt-style consecutive embedding-distance peaks. Break where 1-cosine exceeds the percentile of adjacent gaps, unless the current group is under minTokens; always break past maxTokens. hash-16 is a stand-in; the RelOp (scan OverlayChunk, filter Strategy) does not change when the model does.

topic.note: Compare the next sentence to the running L2-normalized mean of the current group. A topic shift is a drop below threshold.

causal.note: Split on discourse cues, tag cause/effect/condition/event/contrast, and pair antecedent with consequent inside a sentence when the cue is mid-clause.
